with us, we should not, when the blood was cool, have threatened our prisoners with the
sword. But since the gods will have it thus, that nothing but our lives may be called ransom,
let it come. Sufficeth a Roman with a Roman's heart can suffer. Augustus lives to think
aunt, and so much for my peculiar care. This one thing only I will entreat, my boy, a Britain

over his occasions, true, so feat, so nurse-like. Let his virtue join with my request, which
